body:
**What you must know:** all 8 gaps are closed in the kit (commit 0a45d26); each has a test that fails on the old kit and passes now. Harmonize gets them with `install.py --update` from kit main: its brief guard then also checks Artifact replies, the cards reminder gets wired, and Claude Code's task tools get turned on (its own hooks are kept). From now on a part, the clerk or a review that writes a post or comment by hand with `ArtifactData` is refused and told the kit command to use instead.

## Your file item (10:3x) and the parity check
Before, `artifact push` handled only the files of the posts it was sending, so an older post never got its files (Harmonize: 130 of 196 posts name files, none opened). Documents also needed a second command. Now:
- **Artifact side:** a push covers the files of every post and comment. Markdown and HTML go in its own batches. Pictures, PDFs and video come back as `Artifact publish` calls, followed by `files-sent`. Anything the Artifact's map already has is never uploaded again. On an attached board the steps name `repos/<id>/kit_docs`.
- **Local side:** `artifact pull` also fetches the map, and `artifact load` puts every picture the posts name into the local copy under its own id: from the repo file, or from an `Artifact read` call it prints. On this board 17 of 17 now load.
- The record of what the Artifact holds is in git (`.kit/artifact-files/`), so a new container no longer starts from scratch.
- An embed whose document is missing now says "Not on this board yet: <path>" instead of disappearing.

## Before / after, gap by gap
`docs/KIT-SCRIPTS.md § The gaps CL30 closed`

## What changes for each role
- **Parts, reviews, runners:** a post or comment is written on the local copy (`board_cli.py set/update/reply`), then `kit.py artifact push`, its batch, then `artifact sent`. After a local write the hook prints the push line, and a Stop is held once while something is unsent. The kit's templates (BOARD, board skill, runner, consultant) now say this.
- **The clerk:** what it writes by hand still passes, because the kit has no command for it: read marks and `waiting_note` on a comment, a new `session_id` on `_orchestrator`, typing dots. Its targeted `where` / limit 1 queries pass too.
- **The orchestrator:** a launch tag only passes with that tag's kit prompt. A part starts only after `kit.py launch <post>` (it leaves `.kit/run/launch/<post>.json`). After `create_session`, the hook names `kit.py launch <post> --session-id <id>`, and a Stop is held until that has run. `kit.py review` and `handover.py` now tag their own calls.
- **Every read on an Artifact board** (`resume`, `train`, `post`, `open`, `since`, `session`, `search`, `queue`, `sections`, `report`) exits 3 on a copy that was never loaded or is more than 15 min old (`kit.artifact.fresh_min`), so a stale `resume` no longer stamps the brief. `KIT_STALE_OK=1` overrides this; `--db` (a named database) is not gated.
- **agy:** the board-kit MCP server enforces the brief guard itself (`board_resume` stamps, and the orchestrator's `board_reply` is refused without a fresh stamp).

## Tests changed, none removed
No file, test or guard was deleted. Older tests that asserted the old rule now assert the new one: `tests/test_orchestrator_guard.py` (a tagged inline prompt, the orchestrator's raw `_trains` / comment `set`, a part's raw dump, now refused; launches carry the launch mark), `tests/test_install_present_runtimes.py` (the new hook, and the guards wired), `tests/test_launch.py` (the copy is marked loaded before push). The templates' "write with `ArtifactData set`" lines were rewritten to the kit's way.

## Commands checked before building
`kit.py commands artifact`, `launch`, `resume`: built on `artifact pull/load/push/sent`, `launch`, `resume`, `board_cli.py`; new only `kit.py artifact status` (what is unsent), `stale_copy`, `launch_mark` and the hook `kit_board_guard.py`.
handoff: Kit main has CL30. In Harmonize: install.py --update from kit main, then `kit.py artifact pull` (it now gets kit_docs/_index too), `load`, `push`: its batches mirror every document its posts name, its text lists the pictures to upload, then files-sent; commit .kit/artifact-files/. Then rebuild the cards (kit-cards).

Harmonize's own gaps 8, 9, 13 and gap 7's start/stop hooks are not in this step

fixed after O52's check (0448fa0): a load with no new pull re-read an old pull and put an old post back (seen live on this post after a container restart); load now consumes what it pulled, test red before, green after; fresh clone 10 of 10, 255 tests

_dashboard / _trains: the guard does NOT ensure a push never overwrites a newer live copy. A doc changed here and never sent is held back (need_pin), but `artifact pin` takes the version a fresh `get` names, so after a pin the push writes this copy over whatever is live (store lists, notes). load's field merge protects only fields the live copy changed since this copy's base. Not fixed here (past 300k; your call): a push could refuse `_` cards unless this session rebuilt them
